entries.title: Psalms 44:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Contemplation of the sons of Korah.>> We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, The deeds You did in their days, In days of old:

entries.title: Psalms 44:2
segments: You drove out the nations with Your hand, But them You planted; You afflicted the peoples, and cast them out.

entries.title: Psalms 44:3
segments: For they did not gain possession of the land by their own sword, Nor did their own arm save them; But it was Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your countenance, Because You favored them.

entries.title: Psalms 44:4
segments: You are my King, O God; Command victories for Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 44:5
segments: Through You we will push down our enemies; Through Your name we will trample those who rise up against us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:6
segments: For I will not trust in my bow, Nor shall my sword save me.

entries.title: Psalms 44:7
segments: But You have saved us from our enemies, And have put to shame those who hated us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:8
segments: In God we boast all day long, And praise Your name forever. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 44:9
segments: ¶But You have cast [us] off and put us to shame, And You do not go out with our armies.

entries.title: Psalms 44:10
segments: You make us turn back from the enemy, And those who hate us have taken spoil for themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 44:11
segments: You have given us up like sheep [intended] for food, And have scattered us among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 44:12
segments: You sell Your people for [next to] nothing, And are not enriched by selling them.

entries.title: Psalms 44:13
segments: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, A scorn and a derision to those all around us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:14
segments: You make us a byword among the nations, A shaking of the head among the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 44:15
segments: My dishonor [is] continually before me, And the shame of my face has covered me,

entries.title: Psalms 44:16
segments: Because of the voice of him who reproaches and reviles, Because of the enemy and the avenger.

entries.title: Psalms 44:17
segments: ¶All this has come upon us; But we have not forgotten You, Nor have we dealt falsely with Your covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 44:18
segments: Our heart has not turned back, Nor have our steps departed from Your way;

entries.title: Psalms 44:19
segments: But You have severely broken us in the place of jackals, And covered us with the shadow of death.

entries.title: Psalms 44:20
segments: If we had forgotten the name of our God, Or stretched out our hands to a foreign god,

entries.title: Psalms 44:21
segments: Would not God search this out? For He knows the secrets of the heart.

entries.title: Psalms 44:22
segments: Yet for Your sake we are killed all day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

entries.title: Psalms 44:23
segments: Awake! Why do You sleep, O Lord? Arise! Do not cast [us] off forever.

entries.title: Psalms 44:24
segments: Why do You hide Your face, [And] forget our affliction and our oppression?

entries.title: Psalms 44:25
segments: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; Our body clings to the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 44:26
segments: Arise for our help, And redeem us for Your mercies' sake.
